messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['There are 23 new messages in your Email Quarantine since you received your last Notification.', 'Facebook Notify sent you a message.', 'Under "Know your Customer (KYC)" ordinance Apple is required by guidelines to effectuate a verification of your information, failure to do so will conclude in termination of your Apple ID within the next three days.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"Email quarantine alerts report new messages, social platforms notify users of incoming messages, and cloud providers demand account verification to prevent termination."}
